settings.headline: Numbing cream FAQ
settings.subhead: Honest answers to the questions people ask most about cosmetic numbing — what it does, how to use it safely, and when to check with your practitioner.
settings.image_alt: Editorial Senseless topical preparation range on a warm off-white background

settings.body:
Every Senseless page includes guidance relevant to that product or topic. This page brings together the questions we’re asked most often — about shipping, products, application, safety, trade accounts and orders.

Senseless is a cosmetic preparation used before treatment, not an anaesthetic, and your practitioner’s guidance always comes first.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: You’ll receive an email with your Royal Mail tracking number as soon as your order is dispatched. If you can’t find it, please check your junk or spam folder. You can also track your parcel using the Royal Mail tracking service.

settings.question: Royal Mail says my order has been delivered, but I can’t find it.
settings.answer: Our parcels are designed to fit through a standard letterbox wherever possible. Please check with anyone else at the property and any safe places the parcel may have been left. If you still can’t locate it, contact us at cs@senseless.uk and we’ll investigate with Royal Mail.

settings.question: Is my order shipped in discreet packaging?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order is dispatched in plain, unbranded packaging — nothing on the outside identifies the contents.

settings.question: Is Senseless designed for professional aesthetic treatments?
settings.answer: Yes. Senseless was developed specifically for aesthetic practitioners. The range is designed for use before procedures such as injectables, microneedling, laser treatments, skin rejuvenation, permanent makeup (SPMU) and waxing. Clinics also stock Senseless for clients preparing for their appointments.

settings.question: Which strength should I choose?
settings.answer: Senseless comes in three strengths because different treatments and clients have different requirements — stronger isn’t automatically better. Our recommendation tool will guide you to the most appropriate option for your planned procedure. If you’re unsure, contact our team before ordering and we’ll be glad to advise.

settings.question: Can I use Senseless alongside another numbing cream?
settings.answer: No. We don’t recommend combining topical preparations. Using more than one product increases the likelihood of skin irritation and makes it harder to identify the cause of any reaction. Use Senseless on its own and follow the application guidance.

settings.question: Do alcohol or caffeine make a difference?
settings.answer: They can. Many practitioners suggest avoiding alcohol and limiting caffeine for at least 24 hours before treatment, as both can affect how comfortable a treatment feels.

settings.question: Why didn’t I feel as comfortable as I expected?
settings.answer:
The most common reasons include:

  • Applying too little product.
  • Removing it sooner than the application guidance recommends.
  • Not covering it where recommended.
  • Individual differences in skin.
  • The type of procedure.

If your experience wasn’t what you expected, contact cs@senseless.uk and we’ll help identify what may have affected it.

settings.question: Are Senseless products compliant?
settings.answer: Yes. Every Senseless product complies with UK cosmetic legislation and is supported by its own Cosmetic Product Safety Report (CPSR), completed by an independent, qualified safety assessor.

settings.question: How do I apply Senseless correctly?
settings.answer: Clean and thoroughly dry the treatment area. Apply a thick, even layer across the whole area to be treated, and cover with occlusive film (such as cling film) where recommended to aid absorption. Allow approximately 45–60 minutes before your procedure unless your practitioner advises otherwise. Full instructions are on our How to Apply page.

settings.question: How much should I apply?
settings.answer: Apply a generous, clearly visible layer over the complete treatment area. Using too little is one of the most common reasons people find it less comfortable than expected.

settings.question: How long before treatment should I apply it?
settings.answer: Allow approximately 45–60 minutes before your procedure, unless your practitioner advises otherwise. Apply it ahead of your appointment rather than at the time of treatment, and always follow your practitioner’s guidance.

settings.question: How long does the comfort last?
settings.answer: Experiences vary, but customers typically describe feeling comfortable for around one to three hours, depending on the product, how it’s applied, skin type and the treatment.

settings.question: Can I use Senseless before anti-wrinkle injections or dermal fillers?
settings.answer: Yes. Many practitioners use Senseless before injectable treatments to help clients feel more comfortable throughout the procedure. Always follow the advice of your treating practitioner.

settings.question: Is Senseless suitable for microneedling?
settings.answer: Yes. Microneedling is one of the most common procedures Senseless is used before, in clinics and in independent practice alike.

settings.question: Can I use Senseless before laser treatments?
settings.answer: Yes. Senseless is commonly used before laser procedures, including laser hair removal and various skin-rejuvenation treatments.

settings.question: Is it suitable before permanent makeup (SPMU)?
settings.answer: Yes. Many SPMU artists use Senseless to help clients feel more comfortable during longer procedures.

settings.question: Do I need to perform a patch test?
settings.answer: Yes. Before your first use, carry out a patch test at least 24 hours beforehand. Apply a small amount to the inside of your wrist or elbow and leave it for 24 hours. If any irritation occurs, do not continue to full application.

settings.question: Can I use Senseless during pregnancy?
settings.answer: Speak to your GP, midwife or healthcare professional before using any topical preparation during pregnancy. Do not use it without appropriate medical advice.

settings.question: Is Senseless suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: If you have sensitive skin, a patch test is especially important. If redness, itching or irritation develops during the patch test, discontinue use. Anyone with an existing skin condition should seek medical advice before use.

settings.question: What should I do if I experience a reaction?
settings.answer: Stop using the product immediately and wash the area thoroughly with clean water. If symptoms persist or worsen, seek medical advice. Don’t use the product again until a healthcare professional advises it’s appropriate.

settings.question: Can I apply Senseless to broken or irritated skin?
settings.answer: No. Do not apply Senseless to broken, inflamed, infected or sunburnt skin. This warning appears on every product label and should always be followed.

settings.question: Do you offer clinic pricing?
settings.answer:
Yes. Senseless offers professional trade accounts for aesthetic clinics, practitioners and studios. Approved partners receive:

  • Trade pricing.
  • Volume discounts.
  • Clinic support.
  • Marketing resources.
  • Priority product launches.
  • Practitioner education.

Visit our Trade Accounts page to apply.

settings.question: Is there a minimum order?
settings.answer: Most trade accounts have no minimum order value, and larger volume discounts become available as your purchasing increases.

settings.question: Can I return my order?
settings.answer: Yes. You have 30 days from receiving your order to request a return. Products must be unopened, unused and returned in their original packaging. Contact cs@senseless.uk with your order number and we’ll guide you through the returns process.

settings.question: How quickly do you dispatch orders?
settings.answer: Orders placed before our daily dispatch cut-off (1pm on working days) are normally dispatched the same working day. Delivery times then depend on the shipping option chosen at checkout.

settings.body:
• Senseless is a UK cosmetic numbing range, formulated in the United Kingdom. It is not a medicine.
  • Numbing is a cosmetic preparation, not an anaesthetic.
  • Apply only to clean, healthy skin, patch test, and follow the product's instructions.
  • Many practitioners apply their own numbing, so check before your appointment.
